note: Reference lists as a tenant would hold them under Detection > Lists. This trainer bundles them; in Google SecOps they are objects you create and maintain, and a query names them with %list_name.

lists.name: sponsor_domains
lists.description: The names the station's machines are allowed to resolve, written in a hurry the morning after Pledge Night by copying every sponsor-looking name out of the week-one logs. Wider than it should be: read it to the end.

lists.name: admin_accounts
lists.description: Accounts allowed to run as a different user on station hosts.

lists.name: blocked_ranges
lists.description: Ranges the gateway blocks since the first case.

lists.name: station_lan
lists.description: The station's own network, including the address pool the VPN gateway hands to remote sessions.

lists.name: lookalike_patterns
lists.description: Shapes of lookalike sender domains: a known sponsor's name with a hyphen pushed into it, or the station's name with a partner suffix.
